references.text: This verse describes the actual event that the reference verse reports on; it provides context for the finding.
Connects the altar (worship) directly with the well (provision) as a unified act of faith.
Shows the progression from conflict to peaceful settlement through God's gift of wells.
Illustrates God's guidance through faithful servants' reports to the patriarch.
Typological connection between the finding of physical water and the finding of the Messiah as 'living water'.
